Poker dice have six sides, one each of an Ace, King, Queen, Jack, 10, and 9, and are used to form a poker hand. The classic poker dice game is played with 5 dice and two or more players. Each player has a total of 3 rolls and the ability to hold dice in between rolls. After the three rolls, the best hand wins. Discover Board Game Arena Rules summary Contents 1 Gameplay 2 Poker Dice Hands 3 Variants 3.1 Life Loss 3.2 Elimination Mode Gameplay Each player has 5 dices with 6 sides (one each of A, K, Q, J, 10, 9). In each round, each player rolls all 5 dice. Then, they may reroll any number of those dice up to twice (click on the dice that you want to reroll). After all rerolls (or when the player stops), compare all hands from highest to lowest. Tied hands are resolved by the dice used in the combination, then by those unused. Note that A > K > Q > J > 10 > 9. Lose lives according to the variant chosen. By default, rank-based life loss is used. Game ends when a player loses all lives. The player with the most remaining lives wins. Poker Dice Hands In the following table, 1 is the best combination while 8 is the worst. Note that there are no suits in this game. Name Example Rank (Standard) Rank (Probability-based) Five of a Kind A-A-A-A-A 1 1 Four of a Kind A-A-A-A-K 2 2 Full House A-A-A-K-K 3 4 Straight A-K-Q-10-J 4 3 Three of a Kind A-A-A-K-Q 5 6 Two Pair A-A-K-K-Q 6 7 One Pair A-A-K-Q-J 7 8 No Combination A-K-Q-J-9 8 5 Variants Number of Lives: 3 or 5 Life Loss: Rank-based life loss, All players except winner lose 1 life or Lowest rank players lose 1 life (Detailed below) Hank Rank: Standard or Probability-based (Described above) Simultaneous Mode: All players play simultaneously. Rolled dice are revealed at the end of the round. Elimination Mode: Off or On (Detailed below) Life Loss Rank-based life loss: The number of lives is multiplied by the number of players - 1. All players lose lives equal to the round rank - 1. If all players tie, all players lose 1 life. All players except winner lose 1 life: All players except the round winner lose 1 life. If all players tie, all players lose 1 life. Lowest rank players lose 1 life: The lowest rank players of the round lose 1 life. If all players tie, all players lose 1 life. Elimination Mode Off: When a player loses all lives, the game ends. All remaining players are ranked by the number of remaining lives. On: When a player loses all lives, the player is eliminated and the game continues. Game ends when only one player is left. [Rating: 2/10] Poker Dice is a really bad version of Yahtzee, or a really bad version of Poker.  It contains none of the planning for the future like in Yahtzee, and none of the tension of reading opponents like in Poker.  Pretty bad overall.

[Rating: 2/10] [Played a few times] A blend of Poker and Yahtzee that manages to be worse than both. Mindless, random, repetitive, mercifully fast.
